meta.name: Bridger BOLT 8in (corrected) - Pack-and-Coast (355 psi pack, 0.30 MMscf budget), 3.5 mph cap
meta.notes: Bridger BOLT nitrogen purge, Campbell County WY (Powder River Basin). CORRECTED 2026-08-31 (v2): the full 14.820 mi route is 8.625" OD x 0.188" WT X-52 (nominal 8") end to end -- confirmed by Kevin. History: the first pass took the KMZ attribute table at face value (8" for the 'BOLT TO HWY 450' leg, 6" for the 'BOLT 241-06H -> BOLT 406-0904H' leg). Kevin then corrected it to all-6". Kevin has now corrected again: the whole line is 8". This supersedes BOTH prior deliverables (BOLT_14.8mi_6in-8in_PackCoast_300k and BOLT_14.8mi_6in_PackCoast_220k) -- do not use either. Two joined KMZ routes, west to east: BOLT 241-06H -> BOLT 406-0904H (MP 0.000-1.625), then BOLT -> HWY 450 (MP 1.625-14.820), tankage at the HWY 450 endpoint, 75 psi outlet. The second KMZ is digitized in reverse (HWY 450 -> BOLT); it was reversed and its end joins the first route's end within 0.003 mi, confirming a continuous run with no gap. Line volume 29,042 ft3 (5,173 bbl). Terrain is benign: 5,020 ft at BOLT, 4,786 ft at HWY 450, crest 5,045 ft at MP 8.5, low 4,771 ft at MP 12.3 - net 234 ft DOWNHILL, only 274 ft of total relief. FLUID ASSUMED: light sweet PRB crude, API ~40 / SG 0.82 / 3.5 cSt - CONFIRM WITH CLIENT. MOP envelope = Barlow at 72% SMYS, uniform 1,632 psi for the full 8" line. This is the code safety ceiling, NOT the operating point - the line needs ~355 psi of drive, so the run carries ~4.6x margin to MOP with zero violations. STRATEGY: PACK-AND-COAST. Pack to 355 psig (the lowest flat drive that sustains the full 3.5 mph cap end to end; 350 psi dips to 3.49 mph, 330 psi to 3.41 mph). Inject a 0.30 MMscf budget - about 3,000 SCFM peak - then shut in the nitrogen and COAST on the stored compressed column to tankage. Pig holds 3.50 mph the whole way; face decays 355 -> 133 psig at arrival, still well clear of the 75 psi outlet. Result: 0.30 MMscf, 4.23 hr, 3.50 mph flat, 0 MOP violations, 0 vent. Continuous 355 psi drive costs 0.74 MMscf for the identical 4.23 hr - pack-and-coast saves 59% of the nitrogen with no speed penalty. The true lean knee is 0.26 MMscf (also 3.50 mph flat); 0.30 MMscf is recommended for the same robustness margin used throughout this job: even at SG 0.86 / 20 cSt (well outside the assumed fluid) it still completes at 2.95 mph min. Below the knee the coast degrades quickly (0.22M -> 2.72 mph, 0.20M -> 2.22 mph, 0.19M -> 1.94 mph) and 0.18M stalls at MP 14.5 (0.3 mi short). SPREAD: single N2 unit, 4,000 SCFM capacity covers the 3,002 SCFM peak demand with margin. No boosters, no pump stations, no BPCV. OPERATIONAL NOTE: 75 psi is the MINIMUM outlet pressure. Against a free 75 psi outlet the 355 psi drive would naturally overspeed the pig, so the receiving facility must throttle at the tank to hold the 3.5 mph cap - same meter-valve control used on THUNDERBIRD.

inputs.fluid_name: Powder River Basin Light Sweet Crude (assumed API 40)
